body: Follow-up to my last note, re-measured against your tree as of 18:2x. Full suite ran 161 scripts with 3 fails, but the tree moved under it (your GameState.gd diff went 177 -> 178 insertions mid-run), so treat that number as a snapshot not a gate. Re-running the three individually just now: contract_clauses_test.gd fails 5, press_conferences_test.gd fails 4, tournaments_test.gd is now CLEAN (rc=0, failures=0) - so that one was transient. Both remaining failures refuse with 'HAS TURNED PRO - THE AMATEUR CIRCUIT IS CLOSED' from the R40 gate at :9905, reached via your _turn_pro refactor. Neither test loads any panel, so R57 is not involved. Suggested focused set before you commit: amateur_circuit_test, entity_pathways_test, contract_clauses_test, press_conferences_test, then the full suite once. R57 is on master as 37bfde2 (ProfileRevampPanel.gd only) and G14 is c3f24d9 - AmateurMatchmaking.gd parses clean, its test is 0 failures.
